title: PhonePe Limit Per Day: PhonePe Transaction Limits for Banks (Updated 2026)
summary: Check the latest PhonePe payment and per day transfer limits for UPI transactions, merchant payments, and bank transfers with updated rules for 2026.
body_markdown:

Toggle


Are you looking for the **PhonePe transaction limit** **per day** ?


The Phonepe limit **Per Day Limit** is Rs. 1,00,000 (1 lakh) per user per day or within 24 hours across all UPI transactions.


##


What is the PhonePe Transaction Limit Per Day (as of 2026)?


- **Per Day Limit:** ₹1,00,000 (₹1 lakh) per user per day across all UPI transactions on PhonePe.
- **Number of Transactions:** Maximum of 20 transactions per day.
- **Money Request Limit:** You can request up to ₹2,000 per day through the PhonePe app.


If you exceed either the amount or the transaction count, you must wait 24 hours before making further UPI transfers.


##


Special Phonepe UPI Limits


- For certain payments (like tax, IPO, hospitals, educational institutions, RBI retail direct), the UPI limit can go up to ₹5 lakh per transaction.
- Some banks may have lower per-transaction or per-day limits, so always check with your bank if you encounter issues.


##


NPCI 30% Volume Cap: Latest Status


- The **proposed 30% market share cap** on UPI transaction volumes per app (such as PhonePe and Google Pay) has **not yet been enforced** .
- **NPCI has extended the deadline for this cap to December 31, 2026** .
- This means, as of now, there is **no cap on the total number of UPI transactions processed by PhonePe** or other major apps for users.
- The cap, when enforced, will be calculated on a rolling basis over the preceding three months and would only affect new user onboarding if an app exceeds 30% market share.

##


**Important Notes:**


- **Per Transaction** : Most banks allow up to ₹1 lakh per UPI transaction, but some like PNB, BoB, Canara, etc., have lower limits.
- **Per Day** : Capped at ₹1 lakh for most banks, but some are lower.
- **Per Week/Month** : Calculated based on daily limits, as most banks do not have explicit weekly/monthly caps.
- **Transaction Count** : Most banks allow up to 20 UPI transactions per day.
